system.description: The @Lookup[@name]'s body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The @Lookup[@name] always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the @Lookup[@name] with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the @Lookup[@name] can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the @Lookup[@name] and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.
